_note: Twelve founders we wrote. This is a regression instrument over authored data, not a claim about a real cohort: it exists so a change to the weights, the prompts or the adapters shows up as a number that moved, and for nothing else. Every founder is built to make some pair in pairs.json have an obvious right answer — the `note` on each says which. Clusters: A (dental operations, the same specific problem), B (the same abstract verb in different fields), C (finance operations), plus a competitor, two mentors and two unrelated founders.
